records.noteEn: Adds source-code protocols for Hanoi and the bandit, retaining the Minecraft profile.

task.zh: 将三盘从 A 柱移至 C 柱，每次只移动顶盘，大盘不能放到小盘上。
task.en: Move three discs from rod A to C, moving only the top disc and never placing a larger disc on a smaller one.

observation.zh: 当前三根柱的盘序、规则和有限历史的文字描述。
observation.en: Text descriptions of rod configurations, rules and bounded history.

action.zh: 6 种有向柱间移动，非法动作保持状态不变。
action.en: Six directed rod-to-rod moves; invalid moves preserve state.

metrics.zh: info.score 为 C 柱上的盘数，completed 为是否完成；终局奖励 100，非法动作 -1，其他为 0。盘数、完成率和累计奖励分别报告。
metrics.en: info.score counts discs on rod C; completed indicates solution. Reward is 100 on completion, -1 for an invalid move and 0 otherwise. Report disc score, completion and return separately.

controls.zh: evaluation.yml 的 Hanoi3Disk 设置为 10 次、每次最多 30 步；固定盘数、env_noise、历史长度和提示词。
controls.en: evaluation.yml specifies 10 iterations and 30 steps for Hanoi3Disk; fix disc count, env_noise, history and prompts.

limits.zh: 这是三盘离散规划任务。环境构造参数 max_steps 控制历史缓存，评测步数上限由外部评测器执行。
limits.en: This is a three-disc discrete planning task. Constructor max_steps controls history; the evaluation harness enforces the rollout step limit.

basis.zh: 将三盘从 A 柱移至 C 柱，每次只移动顶盘，大盘不能放到小盘上。
basis.en: Move three discs from rod A to C, moving only the top disc and never placing a larger disc on a smaller one.

version.zh: SmartPlay 官方代码与 evaluation.yml，核对于 2026-11-01。
version.en: SmartPlay official code and evaluation.yml, checked 2026-11-01.

termination.zh: 全部盘到达 C 柱；或外部评测步数用尽。
termination.en: All discs reach C, or the external rollout budget is exhausted.

task.zh: 在支付概率为 0.8 和 0.2 的两个臂中，根据交互反馈学习选择。每次 reset 打乱臂顺序。
task.en: Learn from feedback to choose between arms with payout probabilities 0.8 and 0.2; reset shuffles arm identities.

observation.zh: 所选臂、所得奖励、规则和历史文字。optimal 为评测真值，不提供给 Agent。
observation.en: Text action/reward feedback, rules and history. optimal is evaluation ground truth, not agent input.

metrics.zh: info.score 累计选择最高期望收益臂的次数；单步 reward 为支付结果。累计收益可另报，不替代官方 score。
metrics.en: info.score counts selections of the highest-expected-return arm; step reward is the payout outcome. Cumulative reward is a separate measure, not the official score.

controls.zh: BanditTwoArmedHighLowFixed；官方 evaluation.yml 使用 20 次 × 50 步。固定随机种子、历史窗口和模型适应方式。
controls.en: BanditTwoArmedHighLowFixed; official evaluation.yml uses 20 iterations × 50 steps. Fix seeds, history and model adaptation.

limits.zh: 固定平稳收益分布中的交互学习；不代表非平稳老虎机或一般长程规划。
limits.en: Interaction learning under stationary payouts; not a nonstationary bandit or general long-horizon planning test.

basis.zh: 在支付概率为 0.8 和 0.2 的两个臂中，根据交互反馈学习选择。每次 reset 打乱臂顺序。
basis.en: Learn from feedback to choose between arms with payout probabilities 0.8 and 0.2; reset shuffles arm identities.
